messages:
harper: Heads-up — we saw ~2% of inbound leads persist as owner=null during enrichment spikes last night (22:10-22:30). Assign ran before enrichment callback in several cases.

rowan: timeline? is this HubSpot-heavy?

harper: mix of HS and SF. Pattern: intake -> enrichment returns 202 -> callback delayed >30s -> assign job checks enrichment flag=false and writes owner=null.

rowan: quick mitigation?

harper: proposal: introduce a 30s handshake window. During window mark lead `pending_assign` instead of owner=null. If enrichment still not complete after window, route to `sdr-overflow` and set `routing_note=overflow_canary`.

rowan: config example:
```
routing.handshake_seconds=30
routing.fallback_pool="sdr-overflow"
routing.mark_pending=true
```

lia: SalesOps asks for a CSV export of any canary/fallback leads so SDRs don't double-reach. Also please add `routing_note` property for visibility.

harper: will add `owner_history` on contact for audits and include `enrich_payload_id` for ML analysis. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 1h. Metrics to watch: `routing.unassigned.rate`, `routing.fallback.count`, `enrich.latency_p95`. Alert if unassigned.rate > 1% over 15m.

rowan: QA tests: delayed callback 70s -> fallback + routing_note; fast callback <10s -> normal assign; duplicate callbacks -> assign idempotency check.

lia: I'll draft the SalesOps message. ops-bot please create a jira for the long-term playbook and exports.

ops-bot: Created TASK-4410: "handshake canary + canary export" assigned to growth-eng. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/TASK-4410 :white_check_mark:

harper: I'll open the HS workflow PR to gate POST /assign on `enrichment_status=complete` or handshake expiry. Will ping here when PR + canary start are live. :thumbsup:
